summary: Enhance your skills in GIS for conservancy and wildlife management. Join our comprehensive training course to protect ecosystems and wildlife effectively.
lede: Remote sensing in wildlife management uses satellite imagery and spatial data to monitor habitats, vegetation and conservation threats. For conservation officers, GIS analysts, park wardens and natural resource managers, this training supports practical monitoring and planning through satellite image processing, habitat and wildlife movement analysis, and mapping threats such as poaching.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with the protection, monitoring, and strategic management of natural resources and wildlife populations.
modules: Remote Sensing Data Acquisition and Processing
Species Distribution Modeling and Climate Resilience
Strategic Reporting and Decision Support Systems
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of ecology or wildlife management principles. Familiarity with spreadsheets (Excel) is required. No prior GIS experience is necessary, though a basic understanding of map reading is beneficial. Participants must bring a laptop capable of running QGIS software.
